We are getting a new look into how Virginians feel about Democratic Governor Abigail Spanberger.  
“It’s cause for, I think, staying the course for Spanberger, and maybe a little less panic from the Spanberger administration,” Randolph-Macon Political Science Professor Rich Meagher told 8News. 
Morning Consult found that in the second quarter of 2026, 54% of registered voters in Virginia approved of the job Spanberger is doing, compared to 37% who disapproved.
